passages.text:
Ajoy Chawla Appointed As Managing Director Of Titan Company
Ajoy Chawla has been appointed as Managing Director (MD) of Titan Company Limited, commencing from January 1, 2026, subject to the approval of shareholders.
Ajoy Chawla, a veteran of the Tata Group, has been appointed as the Managing Director of Titan Company Limited, effective January 1, 2026, subject to shareholder approval.
Chawla joined the Tata Administrative Services (TAS) in 1990 and began his journey with Titan’s finance department in 1991. Over the past three decades, he has held diverse leadership roles across multiple business units. From 2013 to 2019, he served as Chief Strategy Officer, where he spearheaded business incubation initiatives and played a pivotal role in building the Fragrances and Taneira ventures.

passages.title: Ajoy Chawla takes charge as Managing Director at Titan Company Limited
passages.text:
After joining Titan in 1991, Ajoy Chawla has spent over three decades shaping key businesses and now leads the company as Managing Director.
Ajoy Chawla has stepped into the role of Managing Director at Titan Company Limited, marking a key leadership transition for the company. The change comes at an important phase of Titan, as it sharpens its focus on long-term growth, category leadership, and global expansion. Effective 1 January 2026, he succeeded C.K. Venkataraman, who retired on 31 December 2025.
A Titan veteran, Ajoy’s journey with the company spans over three decades. He joined Titan in 1991 and has since played a defining role in shaping several of its core and emerging businesses. Over the years, he has held multiple leadership positions across sales, retailing, brand management, strategy, and business incubation.

passages.title: Arun Narayan To Succeed Ajoy Chawla as Titan’s Jewellery Division CEO in 2026
passages.text:
Titan Company Limited has announced two major senior leadership transitions as part of its succession planning, effective August 2025 and January 2026. Following earlier disclosures, Ajoy Chawla, CEO of the Jewellery Division, is set to take over as Managing Director of Titan from 1st January 2026. In line with this, Arun Narayan, who currently heads Tanishq India’s Retail, Marketing and Merchandising, will be elevated to CEO of the Jewellery Division from the same date.
Separately, Kuruvilla Markose, currently CEO of Titan’s International Business Division, will succeed Suparna Mitra as CEO of the Watches Division, effective 13th August 2025. Mitra had earlier announced her resignation.
Narayan is an IIM Calcutta alumnus and Tata Administrative Services (TAS) officer with nearly 30 years of experience across various leadership roles in the Tata Group and Titan, including Retail and Sales leadership for Titan Watches and Helios.
Markose, also from the TAS cadre, holds degrees in Agriculture and an MBA from IIFT. He has led Titan’s digital and international business initiatives since 2015, drawing on over three decades of cross-sectoral experience.

passages.text: Mr. C K Venkataraman superannuated on 31st December 2025, concluding a tenure marked by exemplary leadership and meaningful value creation for the Company. Title: Titan Co Announces Senior Mgmt Rejig; Ajoy Chawla to be MD From Jan 2026 – Outlook Business
Tata group firm Titan Company Ltd on Friday announced top management changes with Ajoy Chawla set to become its Managing Director from January 1, 2026, succeeding incumbent C K Venkataraman.
Chawla is currently the CEO of the company's jewellery division, Titan Company said in a regulatory filing.
As part of the changes, Arun Narayan, head of Tanishq India business, will become CEO of its jewellery division from January 1, 2026, while Kuruvilla Markose, currently the CEO of the company's international business division, will succeed Suparna Mitra as the CEO of the watches division with effect from August 13, 2025, it added.
Mitra, CEO of the Watches Division, has resigned with effect from August 12, 2025, it added.
Narayan, presently leading Tanishq India business responsible for retail, marketing and merchandising, will succeed Ajoy Chawla as the CEO of the jewellery division with effect from January 1, 2026, the company said.
He has been leading the Tanishq India business since April 2020 and held key leadership positions in the company earlier as Regional Business Head (West, all categories), Helios Business Head, and National Sales & Retail Head - Titan watches.
He has nearly three decades of experience with the Tata group and Titan in retail, marketing and sales leadership roles and is from the Tata Administrative Services cadre and a postgraduate from IIM Calcutta, the filing said.

Similarly, Markose joined the Tata Administrative Services in 1995. He has three decades of experience in various sectors, including FMCG, Telecom, BPO, Consulting, Digital, and Retail across the Tata Group.
He joined Titan Company Ltd as Chief Digital Officer in 2015 and is currently leading international expansion in watches, jewellery, and eyecare, the filing said.
